title: Cyberworld
content: I regularly visit a cyberworld where a lot of people have merged with machines. It's rather violent and people are not inhibited the way we are. It feels like a simulated future more than anything. Some of it is neat stuff like VR games from the 90s but it actually works, gadgets and toys. Other stuff is like war machines that mess with reality in ways we never would even if we could. Then there's a lot of marginalized people who use tech to mask how they hurt. I know other people visit this place because I saw someone make art of exactly a thing I saw that was really upsetting. Cyberpunk 2077 pulls at your heartstrings but it doesn't leave you deeply disturbed like this did. Any other visitors to that place? I'd like to hear your thoughts.
